name: devtools
description: Guided workflows for developers building apps and integrations on the Meta Social Technologies Developer Platform (developers.facebook.com): settings, webhooks, compliance, app review, and API health. Requires the Meta Social Technologies MCP (formerly Meta Developer Tools MCP). WhatsApp Business setup also requires the WhatsApp Business Tools MCP (https://mcp.facebook.com/whatsapp_business_tools).

interface.shortDescription: For developers on developers.facebook.com — manage the Meta apps you build: settings, webhooks, compliance, app review, and API health.
